_template: Constraints the implementer must honour. Every value below is an example to replace. Each entry carries an evidence label (observed, inferred, designed, structurally-validated, live-verified, not-verified) and, where it comes from policy or documentation, the source or evidence register ID. Quotas and SKU availability stay not-verified until checked for the exact subscription and region.

exceptions.rule: 3-24 lowercase letters and digits, globally unique, no hyphens
exceptions.label: observed

exceptions.rule: keep current names; renaming a live globally unique resource means recreation and data migration
exceptions.label: designed

policy.effect: Deny on resource groups, Modify to inherit on resources
policy.label: observed

policy.intent: private DNS zones are platform-owned; workloads must not create them
policy.label: observed

skus.allowed: tiers that support zone redundancy in REG-PRI
skus.label: not-verified

quotas.resource: vCPU or service capacity for SVC-APP
quotas.label: not-verified

identity.rule: no long-lived secrets; managed identities and workload federation only
identity.label: designed

identity.rule: deployment identity scoped to RG-APP and RG-DATA; role assignments made by the platform team
identity.label: designed

network.rule: spoke address space allocated from platform IPAM; no overlap with on-premises ranges
network.label: designed

network.rule: data services disable public network access
network.label: designed

data.deletion: on request within the legal deadline
data.label: observed

evidence_required: what-if or plan output for the exact commit
approval_gates.label: designed

approval_gates.action: any change to management groups, policy or RBAC
approval_gates.label: designed
